# Off-brief fixture draft (fixture-only synthetic)

## Introduction

This report argues that a named supply chain can use sustainability to defend its position.

## Literature review

The review sets out what the papers say about green supply chains and lists the main themes in the field.

## Drivers of sustainability-centric SCM

Regulation and buyer expectations push Inditex to publish targets, and energy costs make waste reduction pay.

## Benefits of integrating sustainability

The benefit is a steadier cost per garment where the audited supplier cuts water use.

## Integration to competitive advantage

The judgement is that the advantage sits in the audited tier, and that the audit's scope is the limit.

## Recession relevance

A downturn shortens order runs, and the audited tier carries the measure, so the advantage survives.

## Conclusion

The line holds inside the audit and fails outside it.

## Recommendations

The chain should publish the audit scope and extend it to shipping next year.
